topic: Iterating over Arrow ListArrays with Value Offsets
principle: When accessing a ListArray's inner flat buffer directly, the buffer is shared across all list elements. You must compute absolute offsets using value_offsets() rather than assuming the buffer is sliced per-element.
instruction: When you call list_array.value(i) to get the inner array for element i, its underlying data buffer is not sliced. If you then need to access the raw flat buffer values directly (e.g., for zero-copy tensor operations), you must use value_offsets() or value_offset() to calculate the correct absolute offset into the shared buffer.
